_Code-synced 2026-09-29 (after drop-harness-01/02: the Python harness, the pydantic-ai layer, curation and every plan/approval surface are gone). `requires-python >= 3.12`; molpy is a declared dependency (molrs is reached only through molpy / `@molcrafts/molrs` in the browser). CLAUDE.md carries the invariants; this file is the module index._

## Inventory (layered)

molab is three domain layers — `workspace` (storage), `knowledge` (OKF documents, above workspace) and `workflow` (graph engine, above workspace) — under an application-service layer (`services`) and two shells (`server`, `cli`), with `plugins` as the extension surface and the React 19 UI downstream of the server's OpenAPI. The DAG is `services → workflow + workspace`, `workflow → workspace`, `knowledge → workspace` (function-body imports only). Cross-layer primitives at the package root and the stdlib-only `molab.fs` seam are citable from any layer.

### Module list

**Layer 0 — `src/molab/` (cross-layer primitives, package root)**

- `molab.entry` — `entry()` registry + `infer_workspace_root` / `load_workspaces` / `find_workflow_for_run` / `load_workflow_from_entrypoint` / `clear_registry`; also `_execute_experiment`, the single seam that writes `ExperimentMetadata.workflow_entrypoint`.

Built into `src/molab/dist/` by `npm run build:web`.

### Public surface

- `molab.__all__`: `Workspace`, `Project`, `Experiment`, `Run`, `RunContext`, `GridSpace`, `ParamSpace`, `UniformSpace`, `Logger`, `get_logger`, `entry`, `config`, `wp` + lazy `Workflow` / `WorkflowCompiler` / `TaskContext` / `WorkflowRuntime`.
- `molab.fs.__all__`: `FileSystem`, `LocalFileSystem`, `DirEntry`, `StatResult`, `PathArg`, `bulk`, `StatMemo`, `FsProfile` / `FsKind` / `detect_fs_profile` + profile constants, `TextWindow` / `read_text_window`.
- `molab.workspace.__all__` (80 names): entities + metadata, `Execution` / `ExecutionStatus` / `RunStatus` / `RETRYABLE_STATUSES` / `TERMINAL_STATUSES`, the Asset family, `FileStore`, `GitHistory`, `WorkspaceContext` + `*Ref`, targets, prune types, `ValidationReport`, typed errors, `atomic_write_json` / `atomic_write_text`. Submodule-only: `runset`, `run.set_run_executor`, `lifecycle_ops`, `execution_dirs`, `naming`, `copilot`, `metrics_seam`, `fs_remote` / `fs_cached`.
- `molab.knowledge.__all__` (30 names): `Knowledge`, the six classes, `Edge` / `EdgeRole`, `SourceRef`, `KnowledgeSourceStore` / `WikiSource` / `search_sources`, `write_knowledge` / `mount_note` / `harvest_run`, `ZoteroItem` / `read_zotero_items`.
- `molab.workflow.__all__` (71 names): authoring, compile, runtime, IR / codec / binding, cache, `execute_run` / `aexecute_run`, `compiled_workflow_for_run` / `can_recover_workflow` / `WorkflowRecoveryError`, errors. `Next` is public here but not in `molab.__all__`.
- `molab.services`: no package-root exports; import the submodule.
- `molab.plugins.__all__`: `CliPlugin` / `ServerPlugin`, `discover_cli_plugins` / `discover_server_plugins` / `discover_ui_plugin_dirs`, `PluginRegistry` / `registry`, `Capability` / `CapabilityNotAvailable`, API-version constants, `signal_shutdown_server_plugins`.

### Data-type ownership (concept → owning module)

| Concept | Owning module |
|---|---|
| Ids, content / definition hashes, slugs | `molab.ids` |
| Cross-host path | `molab.path` |
| Atomic write + advisory lock | `molab.atomicio` |
| Filesystem Protocol + local implementation | `molab.fs` |
| Per-run profile config | `molab.profile` |
| Process-global in-code config | `molab.config` |
| `Folder` family, CRUD, directory naming | `molab.workspace.folder` / subclasses / `naming` |
| Run definition + `definition_hash` | `molab.workspace.run` |
| One attempt (`Execution`, `execution.json`) + mode path | `molab.workspace.execution_repository` |
| Execution directory declarations | `molab.workspace.execution_dirs` |
| Zombie reaping / cancel / prune verb cores | `molab.workspace.run_reaper` / `lifecycle_ops` / `prune` |
| Sweep container | `molab.workspace.runset` |
| Assets + per-scope manifests + scan queries | `molab.workspace.assets` |
| Emitted artifacts (read from Executions) | `molab.workspace.artifact_repository` |
| Workspace history (git commits + trailers) | `molab.workspace.history` |
| Compute targets + named registry | `molab.workspace.target` / `targets` |
| `WorkspaceContext` read-model, copilot summary | `molab.workspace.workspace_context` / `copilot` |
| Metrics writer seam | `molab.workspace.metrics_seam` (implemented by `molab.plugins.metrics`) |
| Knowledge documents, concept registry, retrieval | `molab.knowledge` |
| Workflow definition / compile / `TaskContext` | `molab.workflow` |
| Task identity + cache | `molab.workflow.snapshot` / `cache` / `cache_store` |
| Graph IR + codec + binding | `molab.workflow.ir` / `codec` / `binding` |
| Workflow recovery for a persisted run | `molab.workflow.recovery` |
| Execution plan, scheduler, node state, resume seeds | `molab.workflow._engine` (private) |
| Operator config (`~/.molab/config.json`) | `molab.services.operator_config` |
| Run-failure analysis | `molab.services.run_failure` |
| Users + sessions for `molab serve` | `molab.services.auth` |
| HTTP envelopes | `molab.server.schemas` |
| Metric file formats | the package that parses them (molrs via `plugins/molrs` in the UI; `molcrafts.metric_readers` server-side) |

### Style summary

- **Primitives / fs** — stdlib only (`molab.fs` has an import-weight test); no I/O at import; `import molab` stays light (no workflow engine loaded until a lazy attr is touched).
- **workspace** — pure-data types are `BaseModel(frozen=True)`; `Folder` subclasses are plain classes with explicit `__init__` and no disk writes in `__init__`; atomic JSON through `molab.atomicio`; upward hand-offs only through seams (`set_run_executor`, `set_workflow_executor`, `set_metrics_writer_factory`); files are the only source of truth, and history is a soft dependency.
- **knowledge** — a document is its path; the head is a class-named JSON file plus `index.md`; a read never writes; the import guard is an AST scan (`tests/test_knowledge/test_import_guard.py`).
- **workflow** — `Workflow` (mutable) → `WorkflowCompiler().compile()` → `CompiledWorkflow` (frozen); task bodies can be sync or async; `cache_key = f(snapshot.key, inputs_hash)` (`tests/test_workflow/test_cache_contract.py`); `pydantic_graph` is banned by a full-src AST scan (`tests/test_workflow/test_engine_boundary.py`); deadlock detection is structural.
- **services** — one backend path per operation for CLI and server; must not import `server` / `cli` / `plugins` (`tests/test_services/test_import_guard.py`).
- **server** — one module per resource; `*Request` / `*Response` schemas; DI via `deps/`; a plugin owns its wire models; the UI treats the server as a filesystem for formats.
- **cli** — flat Typer tree; the `runs` group is plural by design; heavy imports are deferred into command bodies.
- **plugins** — every entry-point load is wrapped and a failure is skipped with a warning; molab registers no entry point of its own.
- **apps/web** — shadcn/ui first; TanStack Query is the only server-state cache; never hand-edit `api/generated/`.

### Layer roles

- Primitives + `molab.fs` — citable from any layer; import no molab business layer.
- `molab.workspace` — bottom storage. Must not import `workflow` / `knowledge` / `services` / `server` / `cli` / `plugins` (`tests/test_workspace/test_import_guard.py`).
- `molab.knowledge` — OKF documents above workspace, reached only through function-body imports; bans `workflow` / `services` / `server` / `cli` / `plugins` at any scope.
- `molab.workflow` — graph engine over workspace (`tests/test_workflow/test_import_guard.py`).
- `molab.services` — application services over workflow + workspace.
- `molab.server` / `molab.cli` — shells over services; they never import each other.
- `molab.plugins` — extension channels plus in-tree optional packages.
- `apps/web/src` — the frontend, downstream of the OpenAPI client, with no Python import edges.

**Enforced DAG.** `services → workflow + workspace`, `workflow → workspace`, `knowledge → workspace` (function body only). Guards live in `tests/test_<layer>/test_import_guard.py` and `tests/test_import_direction.py` (which also asserts that `molab.harness` is not importable).

**Packaging.** `pip install` never invokes npm; the UI is prebuilt into `src/molab/dist/` (`-C build-web=true` for the wheel). Extras: `tensorboard`, `all`, `conformance` (molrec, test-only), `dev`.
